caption:
👶🔴 Red rash in the nappy area? It's usually easy to fix.

✨ Remember A B C D E:
🅰️ Air: nappy-free time every day
🅱️ Barrier: zinc cream or petroleum jelly
©️ Clean gently with water & a soft cloth
🇩 Diaper: change often, right size
🇪 Educate: no scented wipes or soap

🔍 Nappy rash or fungal?
• Nappy rash: red, shiny skin, skin folds are spared → barrier cream
• Fungal (thrush): bright red in the folds with small spots around → see a doctor

❌ Please don't:
• Use talcum powder
• Keep tight nappies on all day
• Use scented wipes or soap
• Use steroid creams without a doctor

🚨 See a doctor if:
• Fever with the rash
• Blisters, pus or open sores
• Rash spreads beyond the nappy area
• Not better after 3 days of care
• Purple spots that don't fade when pressed
• Baby is unwell or not feeding
